question: 1. Display the total number of employees.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP;

question: 2. Display the total salary of all employees.
query: SELECT SUM(SAL) FROM EMP;

question: 3. Display the average salary of all employees.
query: SELECT AVG(SAL) FROM EMP;

question: 4. Display the highest salary.
query: SELECT MAX(SAL) FROM EMP;

question: 5. Display the lowest salary.
query: SELECT MIN(SAL) FROM EMP;

question: 6. Display the total number of departments in the EMP table.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DEPTNO) FROM EMP;

question: 7. Display the number of employees who are managers.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MGR) FROM EMP;

question: 8. Display the total commission paid to employees.
query: SELECT SUM(COMM) FROM EMP;

question: 9. Display the average commission.
query: SELECT AVG(COMM) FROM EMP;

question: 10. Display the number of employees who are getting commission.
query: SELECT COUNT(COMM) FROM EMP;

question: 11. Display department-wise total salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, SUM(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 12. Display department-wise average salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, AVG(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 13. Display department-wise number of employees.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, COUNT(*) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 14. Display job-wise number of employees.
query: SELECT JOB, COUNT(*) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB;

question: 15. Display job-wise total salary.
query: SELECT JOB, SUM(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB;

question: 16. Display job-wise maximum salary.
query: SELECT JOB, MAX(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB;

question: 17. Display job-wise minimum salary.
query: SELECT JOB, MIN(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB;

question: 18. Display department-wise maximum salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, MAX(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 19. Display department-wise minimum salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, MIN(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 20. Display department-wise average commission.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, AVG(COMM) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

question: 21. Display department-wise job-wise number of employees.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, JOB, COUNT(*) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, JOB;

question: 22. Display department-wise job-wise total salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, JOB, SUM(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, JOB;

question: 23. Display department-wise job-wise average salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, JOB, AVG(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, JOB;

question: 24. Display job-wise department-wise maximum salary.
query: SELECT JOB, DEPTNO, MAX(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB, DEPTNO;

question: 25. Display job-wise department-wise minimum salary.
query: SELECT JOB, DEPTNO, MIN(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB, DEPTNO;

question: 26. Display department and job having the highest total salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, JOB, SUM(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, JOB HAVING SUM(SAL) = (SELECT MAX(SUM(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, JOB);

question: 27. Display the department where the sum of salaries is maximum.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING SUM(SAL) = (SELECT MAX(SUM(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 28. Display the job having the minimum average salary.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB HAVING AVG(SAL) = (SELECT MIN(AVG(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB);

question: 29. Display jobs having an average salary greater than the overall average salary.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB HAVING AVG(SAL) > (SELECT AVG(SAL) FROM EMP);

question: 30. Display the department having the highest number of employees.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(COUNT(*)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 31. Display jobs whose total salary is more than the salary of all CLERKs combined.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB HAVING SUM(SAL) > (SELECT SUM(SAL) FROM EMP WHERE JOB='CLERK');

question: 32. Display departments having the same number of employees.
query: SELECT COUNT(*), DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) IN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO GROUP BY COUNT(*) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);
output: No departments have equal counts in standard EMP table.

question: 33. Display jobs where the max salary is equal to the department 20 max salary.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB HAVING MAX(SAL) = (SELECT MAX(SAL) FROM EMP WHERE DEPTNO=20);

question: 34. Display the department having the minimum total salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING SUM(SAL) = (SELECT MIN(SUM(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO);

question: 35. Display the job having the highest average salary.
query: SELECT JOB FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB HAVING AVG(SAL) = (SELECT MAX(AVG(SAL)) FROM EMP GROUP BY JOB);

question: 36. Display dept no and total salary where avg salary > overall avg salary.
query: SELECT DEPTNO, SUM(SAL) FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING AVG(SAL) > (SELECT AVG(SAL) FROM EMP);

question: 37. Display job-wise count of employees not getting commission.
query: SELECT JOB, COUNT(*) FROM EMP WHERE COMM IS NULL GROUP BY JOB;

question: 38. Display departments where no employee gets commission.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING SUM(NVL(COMM,0)) = 0;

question: 39. Display departments where all employees get commission.
query: SELECT DEPTNO FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(COMM);

question: 40. Display job-wise average commission.

question: 41. Display department-wise count of employees where manager is NULL.

question: 42. Display the number of employees without commission.

question: 43. Display total commission paid (ignore NULLs).

question: 44. Display department-wise average commission excluding NULLs.

question: 45. Display job-wise total commission.

question: 46. Display department-wise count of employees getting commission.

question: 47. Display jobs having more than one manager.

question: 48. Display departments having employees with commission.

question: 49. Display job-wise average salary where total salary > 5000.

question: 50. Display department-wise total salary where employee count > 4.

question: 54. Display departments whose total salary is greater than 10000.

question: 55. Display jobs having an average salary greater than 2500.

question: 57. Display dept-wise count for SALESMAN and total comm.

question: 58. Display job-wise max salary where salary > 1500.

question: 59. Display department-wise total salary excluding department 30.

question: 60. Display job-wise average salary where department is 20.

question: 61. Display department-wise number of employees where commission is NOT NULL.

question: 67. Display department-wise job-wise employee count.
